The '''Rendili StarDrive Y-wing''' was a variant of [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing's]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BLT Y-wing starfighter]] designed by [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]]. Unlike its predecessor, the Rendili StarDrive Y-wing was constructed with [[Transport/Legends|passenger transportation]] in mind, being much larger than the typical BTL Y-wing model so that it could ferry three passengers alongside a designated [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech co-pilot]]. At least [[Luke Skywalker's Rendili StarDrive Y-wing|one of these vessels]] was owned by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] while he was acting as an agent for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Senate Planetary Intelligence Network]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].

==Description==
{{Quote|''Unlike the standard Y-wing spaceship, which was only big enough for a two-man crew and one astromech droid, the modified Rendili Y-wing was large enough to hold a crew of four.''|''[[Prophets of the Dark Side (novel)|Prophets of the Dark Side's]]'' description of the Rendili Y-wing|<ref name="POTDS" />}}
The Rendili StarDrive Y-wing bore a striking similarity to the design of the [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter]]; except its [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit pod]] was substantially bigger to hold the additional passengers.  While the Rendili StarDrive Y-wing does not possess an official length, its visual depiction within ''[[Prophets of the Dark Side (novel)|Prophets of the Dark Side]]'' shows it to be substantially bigger than the BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter's length of 16 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="Rebel Sourcebook">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> Given that the visual references do not show the Rendili Y-wing to differ in terms of the proportion of its cockpit to the rest of its design, the length of the ship's frame and its famed y-shaped thrusters appear to have been increased in size.<ref name="POTDS" />

==Appearance==
*''[[Prophets of the Dark Side (novel)|Prophets of the Dark Side]]'' {{1st}}
